title: How Sweet and Awful is the Place
lyrics_original: How sweet and awful is the place
Here every kindness of our God

bible_verses.english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forevermore.
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for welcoming me into Your presence with such boundless grace and soft compassion. I am humbled by the great price You paid to purchase my peace and pardon on the cross. Today, I bring my weary soul to You, asking to be nourished by Your everlasting love. Teach me to rest in the sweetness of Your mercy and to live in reverent awe of Your goodness. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: To step into the presence of Christ is to experience a wondrous mix of sacred awe and profound sweetness. At His table, we are met not with judgment, but with a feast of gentle compassion and undeserved mercy—all secured through His precious blood. As we draw near, our weary hearts are reminded that we are fully known and deeply loved. May this song draw you into reverent worship, inviting you to rest in the peace and pardon Jesus freely offers today.
